import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load sample submission to get target species order
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))
target_columns = list(sample_submission.columns[1:])
n_classes = len(target_columns)

# Load training data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))

# Create feature columns (margin, shape, texture - 64 each)
feature_cols = (
    [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
    + [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
    + [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
)

# Extract features and target
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
y_train = train_df["species"].values
test_features = test_df[feature_cols].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Convert species names to integer indices
species_to_idx = {species: idx for idx, species in enumerate(target_columns)}
y_train_int = np.array([species_to_idx[s] for s in y_train])

# Hold-out validation split (80/20, stratified)
X_train_split, X_val, y_train_int_split, y_val_int = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train_int, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_int
)

# Train XGBoost classifier
xgb_clf = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    min_child_weight=3,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
    n_jobs=-1,
)
xgb_clf.fit(X_train_split, y_train_int_split)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_pred = xgb_clf.predict_proba(X_val)
y_val_pred = np.clip(y_val_pred, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
y_val_pred = y_val_pred / y_val_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


# Calculate logloss
def compute_logloss(y_true_labels, y_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_proba_clipped = np.clip(y_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros((y_true_labels.shape[0], n_classes))
    for i, true_label in enumerate(y_true_labels):
        y_true_one_hot[i, true_label] = 1
    logloss = -np.mean(np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_proba_clipped), axis=1))
    return logloss


val_logloss = compute_logloss(y_val_int, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation LogLoss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Make predictions on test set
test_pred_proba = xgb_clf.predict_proba(test_features)
test_pred_proba = np.clip(test_pred_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_pred_proba = test_pred_proba / test_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        **{col: test_pred_proba[:, i] for i, col in enumerate(target_columns)},
    }
)

submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
